feeds.title: SavvyFi Blog
feeds.description: Learn everything you need to know about 529 plans, employer student loan benefits & saving for educational expenses with SavvyFi's blog. SavvyFi is a user-friendly platform that makes it easy to set up 529 college savings plans and takes the guesswork out of setting up a plan.

feeds.title: College Countdown
feeds.description: The College Countdown blog from ScholarShare 529 offers resources for Parents to help them plan for their kid's higher education. Explore in-depth articles on 529 plans, Finacial aid, Scholarships, and more. College Countdown is a program offered by ScholarShare 529, California's official college savings plan, dedicated to helping parents prepare to send their kids to college.

feeds.title: 529 College Savings Plans Blog
feeds.description: Our blog provides the latest news and reports, insights, and other helpful media to aid you in your financial preparation for higher education. Learn tips, savings advice, and more in the latest posts. College Savings Plans Network (CSPN) was formed to make higher education more attainable and serves as a clearinghouse for information among state-administered college savings programs.
